notes: 32 rollouts with supported settings plus four exploratory rollouts with a 10 ms controller period.
The 10 ms controller period used the same per-step learning settings and a smaller increment limit; it does not isolate integrator accuracy.
The public example fixes the controller period at 20 ms and supports independent RK4 substeps.
Parameter/history differences before the event are checked to 1e-10 to allow floating-point event splitting.
Healthy adaptive tracking is worse than healthy frozen tracking in the default run.
